applyTo: '**'

## STRICT ERROR HANDLING RULES

1. All error messages must be printed only to the console.
2. Displaying error messages in any GUI element is strictly prohibited.
3. Errors must not be suppressed or hidden from the console output.
4. No fallback mechanism is allowed to prevent errors from surfacing.
5. Errors must be allowed to occur naturally; do not attempt to bypass them.
6. Never redirect or log errors to any GUI component or notification.
7. Do not attempt to mask, catch, or ignore errors to maintain application flow.
8. Every error must be visible and traceable through the console output.
9. Any attempt to handle errors by providing alternative logic is forbidden.
10. Treat errors as essential feedback; do not attempt to eliminate or silence them unnaturally.
